portInfo.description: Port Otago Limited describes itself as New Zealand’s always-open primary export port for the lower South Island. Its site includes a Cruise section covering cruise schedule, wharf access, passenger information, tour operators’ information and cruise-specific policies. General enquiries +64 3 472 7890. Dedicated cruise berth LOA was not published on the captured homepage (cruise deep URL 404).

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Dunedin city / railway station — ~180 min with transfer.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Layer up — harbour wind chill is real.
